thread:
Jia: Hey team — proposing a small cross-team kickoff for a regional/zone observability surface. Goal: one dashboard in Console that shows latency by region, traffic split effects, and a simple failover impact view. Who's available to help define the telemetry schema?

Kevin: I can help define what runtime can emit. Quick Q: do we want region labels on every span/request or only on edge/proxy hops?

Ayesha: infra prefers region labels at the LB/proxy layer + an origin_region header preserved by the runtime. That lets us see cross-region client traffic vs intra-region.

Tom: runtime can emit two labels: request_region (where request served) and routed_from (if it was forwarded). We can also add failover_reason with values like 'capacity', 'healthcheck', 'policy'.

Lina: Nice. For Console dashboards we'll want: p50/p95/p99 latency by request_region, requests/sec by (request_region, routed_from), and a failover-rate metric (count of requests with routed_from != request_region). Also a traffic-split panel showing percent of traffic to each model variant per region.

Sophie: UX ask: when someone sees a cross-region spike, they should be able to click into the rollout/policy that caused it (e.g., circuit-breaker fallback). Can we tag rollout_id or policy_id on the metrics?

Tom: Yes, we can include rollout_id when a routing policy causes an override. That will be optional but very useful. Adds cardinality though — we should only attach rollout_id for sampled events or as labels on aggregated counters, not on high-cardinality timers.

Kevin: To keep cardinality sane, plan: low-card counters with rollout_id, high-res histograms without. Also add quantiles aggregated per-request_region/model_family.

Ayesha: From infra side we need consistent zone naming: use region:zone format (e.g., us-west-2a). Can we standardize on labels: request_region, request_zone, routed_region, routed_zone, rollout_id, failover_reason, model_family?

Lina: That label set works. Example PromQL we might use for failover rate: 
```
sum by (request_region) (increase(requests_total{routed_region!~""}[5m])) / sum by (request_region) (increase(requests_total[5m]))
```
(we'll translate to whatever query language Console uses). For latency p95 by region: 
```
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, request_region))
```

Jia: Good — can someone draft a concise telemetry spec we can land in a PR? Include which metrics are counters vs histograms and label cardinality notes.

Tom: I'll draft runtime changes: emit request_duration histogram (service-level), requests_total counter with routed_region label, and routed_reason counter. Also add optional rollout_id on a low-card counter. Will include example config.

Kevin: I'll coordinate the SDK change to preserve X-Origin-Region header and ensure proxies don't strip it.

Ayesha: I'll add infra checklist: LB adds routed_region tag, ensure metrics exporter maps zone tags to region_zone label, and update the K8s node-label crawler.

Lina: I'll prototype the dashboard panels in Grafana (to iterate fast) and then convert to Console DSL. Will add a panel for traffic-split by model variant and a timeline for rollout_id events.

Sophie: Could product provide a small set of test scenarios (e.g., simulate zone failure causing 20% traffic shift) so we can validate panels?

Jia: Yes, Sophie will add scenarios. Action items: Tom runtime spec PR by Thu, Kevin header/SDK change by Thu, Ayesha infra checklist by Fri, Lina dashboard prototype by next Tue, Sophie test scenarios by Fri.

opsbot: deploy-bot posted: Deployment 2026-03-17T12:34:00Z - kaolin-runtime v2.14 -> us-west-2.

Kevin: Noted — we'll target a canary in us-west-2 first so we can validate region labels.

Ayesha: One more thing — telemetry for traffic-splits: we should emit split_percentage label on a per-route counter or a separate gauge per route+variant. Thoughts?

Tom: Separate gauge per route+variant sounds better (lower churn for counters). We'll emit route_variant_split_gauge{route,variant,request_region}.

Lina: Perfect, that feeds directly into the traffic-split panel. Also would be good to have an alert: if failover_rate > 5% in any region for 10m -> page oncall and open a ticket.

Jia: Agreed. Last bit: who owns the Console migration of the prototype? Lina + Product (Sophie) pair?

Sophie: Yes, I'll pair with Lina for the UX handoff.

Jia: Thanks everyone. I'll file a meta ticket with the spec and the action items and link this thread.

Kevin: Thanks. Ping me if you want help with tests for header preservation.

Tom: PR will mention this thread.

Lina: I'll drop the Grafana link once prototype is ready.

Ayesha: Adding infra card to backlog now.

Jia: Closing the loop — will post the ticket link here once created. :thumbsup:
